races.paceDynamic: Irina's Path is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate proceedings from the outset, likely setting a measured gallop without sustained pressure from rivals. The vast majority of this field are hold-up performers (Dacman, Hey Sir, Asphalt Cowboy, Last Round, Hearts And Spades, Squire Ohara, Keenaghan Lass, Gethegoodtimesroll) who will settle behind the pace and look to pounce late. Fr Gilligansvoyge might track closer as a prominent runner but lacks the class to sustain pressure on the leader. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can capitalise on the uncontested pace and finish with late momentum over the extended trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Irina's Path sets an uncontested pace with the field settling behind...
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up performers get the perfect tactical setup to unleash finishing kicks over the final half-mile. Quality horses like Last Round and Hearts And Spades can time their challenges to perfection.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Irina's Path maintains strong gallop and no challenger emerges early...
scenarios.body: The leader gets an armchair ride for most of the journey and has enough left to resist late challenges up the hill. The lack of pace pressure throughout proves decisive for stamina conservation.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactics Win
scenarios.trigger: If Fr Gilligansvoyge tracks closer and applies earlier pressure to Irina's Path...
scenarios.body: The race becomes more truly run, suiting horses that can race handily without being stuck in traffic. This scenario reduces the effectiveness of pure hold-up tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lightly Raced Improver
scenarios.trigger: If one of the unknown quantities like Heartbreak Weather or Jetbob shows significant improvement...
scenarios.body: The consistent recent form and unknown ceiling creates an upset possibility. However, the weight of evidence favours more exposed performers with proven ability at this level.

Amateur jockeys throughout field could lead to tactical errors or poor positioning in crucial closing stages
Keenaghan Lass receiving significant weight allowance but her 364-day absence raises serious fitness questions

races.paceDynamic: Panda Boy will take this field along at a measured gallop over the extended trip, with no obvious pressure from the early stages. The prominent brigade including Its On The Line, Asian Master, and Wonderwall will settle in behind the leader, while the hold-up horses Hunters Yarn, Five Star Getaway, and Ambitious Fellow will need to navigate traffic from the rear. The lack of pace pressure should create a tactical affair that builds from the home turn, with the final half-mile becoming crucial. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the pace and have something left for a sustained finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Play
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays controlled throughout and the prominent horses get first run
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows horses like Its On The Line and Asian Master to conserve energy in ideal positions before unleashing their finishing kicks. These prominent racers avoid the traffic problems that will engulf the hold-up brigade in a slowly-run contest.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens notably from halfway and the field stretches out
scenarios.body: The increased tempo plays perfectly into the hands of Hunters Yarn and Five Star Getaway who can use their finishing speed without getting trapped. Both possess the class to pick off tiring leaders when given clear runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Panda Boy Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If no horse can match Panda Boy's sustained gallop and he maintains his advantage
scenarios.body: The confirmed front-runner gets an uncontested lead and proves too game in the closing stages for the challengers. His recent winning form and tactical advantage prove decisive when others struggle to make inroads.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Panda Boy stops quickly and the race becomes a sprint from the last fence
scenarios.body: The collapse of the pace-setter creates chaos with multiple horses hitting the front simultaneously. Fresher horses with recent form like Cause For Comment can capitalize on the messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Panda Boy could get too soft a lead early and prove impossible to peg back if no horse goes with him

Asian Master's recent course form makes him dangerous despite modest speed figures
Wonderwall's 49-day absence could blunt his finishing effort despite the tongue-tie addition
Five Star Getaway's patient tactics need genuine pace to be effective in this tactical affair

races.paceDynamic: Dinoblue and Spindleberry will lock horns from the start, with both proven front runners likely to dispute the early lead in this small field. Their duel should create an honest gallop that will test stamina reserves over this extended trip. Kala Conti and Only By Night can track the leaders closely, while Broomfield Bijou and Sophia Rose face the challenge of giving away significant weight from prominent positions. This pace setup strongly favours horses that can sit handy and pounce late, rather than those forced to make the running throughout.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dinoblue Dictates Terms
scenarios.trigger: If Dinoblue can establish a clear lead over Spindleberry early and control the fractions.
scenarios.body: The class mare can utilise her superior rating and recent Grade 1 form to kick clear when the pace lifts. Her proven ability at this trip on similar going makes her the one to beat if allowed to dominate.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: This allows the prominent runners to conserve energy and the race becomes a sprint from the last fence. Kala Conti's improving form and fresher profile could prove decisive in a finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runners Collapse

scenarios.body: The sustained pace takes its toll on the leaders, opening the door for a prominent runner to sweep past. Only By Night's recent consistent form suggests she could capitalise on such a scenario.

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.trigger: If the pace is truly run and the class horses underperform on the day.
scenarios.body: Broomfield Bijou gets a significant weight allowance and recent winner's confidence could see her outrun her odds. Her trainer rarely runs one without a chance at this level.

races.paceDynamic: Port Joulain, Kiss Will, You Oughta Know and Karamoja will set a strong gallop from the flag, with 10 prominent runners creating heavy congestion behind the leaders. The pace will be testing over 2m4½f, putting stamina at a premium and likely causing traffic problems approaching the business end. With multiple front-runners guaranteed to go forward and the large field creating tactical complications, this race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early scramble and finish with one sustained run.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace proves genuinely strong and traffic develops 2-3 out

scenarios.title: Chaos Benefits Outsider

races.paceDynamic: Jalon d'Oudairies and Kiely's Place will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a solid but not breakneck gallop over this testing 2m4½f trip. Behind them, King Rasko Grey, You Proof, Kalypso'chance, Echoing Silence, Bon Viveur and Saint Baco all want prominent positions, creating congestion and potential traffic problems from 3 out. Lord Byron as the sole hold-up horse has tactical freedom but faces a wall of horses to navigate late. This pace setup and prominent congestion strongly favours the front two who can avoid trouble, plus any horse with the class to dominate from an early prominent position.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Two Pull Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Jalon d'Oudairies and Kiely's Place establish a clear lead without being pressed hard by the prominent pack.
scenarios.body: The two leaders get into a rhythm without excessive early pressure, then one kicks clear approaching the last while the prominent brigade gets tangled up behind. This setup perfectly suits horses who can lead or sit just behind the pace without traffic concerns.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the higher-rated prominent runners can secure an ideal pitch just behind the leaders without getting caught in traffic.
scenarios.body: King Rasko Grey or Echoing Silence use their class advantage to sit in the perfect stalking position, then power past the leaders approaching the last hurdle. The Mullins-trained quartet have multiple chances to land this scenario with their numerical advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack goes too hard trying to get into position and sets it up for Lord Byron's trademark finish.
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable as six horses scrap for prominent positions, leaving Lord Byron with a perfect stalking brief for Harry Cobden. His superior class tells in the final 100 yards as others tire from their earlier exertions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Outsider Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and one of the outsiders finds a dream passage through.
scenarios.body: The two leaders go too slow, the prominent horses leave their run too late, and a horse like Saint Baco or You Proof sneaks up the inner with perfect timing. This requires multiple things to go wrong for the favorites but stranger things have happened in Grade 1s.

Jalon d'Oudairies and Kiely's Place disputing lead - if one gets easy time in front they become very dangerous.

races.paceDynamic: Lossiemouth, Anzadam, and Wilful will clash from the start, creating a relentless gallop over this sharp 2-mile track. The trio's natural front-running styles guarantee early positioning battles and sustained pace throughout. With three confirmed pace-setters in a small field, stamina and jumping accuracy under pressure become paramount. This setup strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can travel prominently without getting embroiled in the early burn-up.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.body: The pace becomes truly testing with tactical speed proving crucial in the final half-mile. Prominent racers who avoid the early battle can pick up the pieces as the leaders pay for their exertions.

scenarios.body: The class mare uses her superior ability to dictate terms and stretch the field with her jumping prowess. Her proven stamina reserves allow her to maintain the gallop when others falter.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Split Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders check each other early allowing tactical positioning
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more moderate initially before quickening, suiting horses who can adapt their position. Those with flexible running styles can capitalise on the changed dynamic.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Collapse Opens Door
scenarios.trigger: If two or more pace-setters make significant jumping errors under pressure
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop creates jumping mistakes that dramatically alter the race complexion. Any horse maintaining fluent jumping rhythm gains massive advantage in the closing stages.

races.paceDynamic: Pioneer Pete, Lincoln Du Seuil, and Walhaan will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with Pioneer Pete likely to dominate early given his consistent front-running style and Jonjo O'Neill Jr's aggressive tactics. With 28 runners and multiple prominent racers like Spirou, Tatateo, and Arslan also likely to press forward, the tempo will be relentless throughout. races.paceDynamic: Cityofblindinlites and Thinkitdontjinxit will dispute the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a solid gallop over this 2m3f trip. Premier Division and Reckless should track prominently behind the leaders, while the large field of hold-up horses including Largy Star, Muted Melody and Muckanagh Lough will need to navigate traffic from the rear. The sustained pace from two keen leaders will stretch the field and create a genuine test of stamina. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical pace who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the back-markers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Favours Class
scenarios.trigger: If Cityofblindinlites and Thinkitdontjinxit maintain a strong gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The honest pace will expose the lesser lights and allow the higher-rated horses like Premier Division and Denham Rock to showcase their superior ability. Class will rise to the surface as the pace takes its toll on the moderate performers.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runners Steal March
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets first run and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: Either Cityofblindinlites or Thinkitdontjinxit could exploit their forward positions to build an unassailable lead before the closers get organized. The yielding ground will make it harder for hold-up horses to make up significant ground late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Traffic Nightmare
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates significant interference in the straight
scenarios.body: The 23-runner field will cause serious traffic problems for horses at the back, allowing those racing prominently to dominate the finish. Horses like Largy Star and Muted Melody could find themselves with nowhere to go at crucial moments.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and come back dramatically
scenarios.body: Should Cityofblindinlites and Thinkitdontjinxit overdo it in the opening stages, patient riders on Largy Star and Muckanagh Lough could time their runs perfectly. The yielding ground would aid their late surge as the early pace-setters tie up.
